interface.shortDescription: Bridge Codex to Gemini or Antigravity for research, citations, and knowledge-base tasks.
interface.longDescription: Multi-backend bridge that brings external agent CLIs (Google Gemini, Google Antigravity) into Codex. Three modes: ask (Q&A with sources), research (deep research → markdown draft), augment (delta-style updates to existing docs). Default backend is Gemini (stable, Google Search grounding); Antigravity backend is experimental and requires a local Antigravity install. Built for cross-border e-commerce / Amazon workflows — prompts preserve domain terminology (ACOS, ASIN, ROAS, BSR, AMC) and enforce source citations. Pairs with codex's own deep-code abilities: codex = depth × code, bridge = breadth × knowledge.
